{"id":"e688e9c7f36fc1fb6d9009cfcfce3276","ts":"1757695108.506159","type":"message","user":"EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID","text":"Hi <@PERSON_6078_SLACK_ID>, the way I see it, playables can be good for optimizing for CPIs (fun casual playable but unrelated to core game), optimizing for retention (filter out users that are not going to like your game), or somewhere in the middle. I think Scenario 1 is a good bet for filtering out the players that won't like our game, while remaining true to our core game play.\n\nFor Scenario 1, would the user be able to select any items they want and make several matches (if they are good enough)? I like that idea -- but will call out it seems a lot more sophisticated than the Domino Delights playable where the user is essentially on rails and only makes a few matches before the playable ends.","channel":"C08H78VJG80","thread_ts":"1757695108.506159","reply_count":4,"reply_users_count":2,"latest_reply":"1758209344.355659","is_activity_message":false,"subtype":null,"reactions":[],"files":[],"attachments":[]}

{"id":"960a78ed83e0aeae26d65c88371f85fd","ts":"1757956024.883249","type":"message","user":"EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID","text":"<@PERSON_6078_SLACK_ID> lets go with Scenario 1. From a design standpoint, I think the main elements to figure out are 1) what items are on the board, and 2) what zombies are being smashed.

For items, we want to highlight that different items have different abilities and choose items that might be especially entertaining to the users. I think grenade (powerful), couch (splash damage), plush doll (weak but potentially funny), would be a good start.

For zombies, we have quite a few at this point. Probably best to use a variety.

What are next steps for us to Push this project forward?","channel":"C08H78VJG80","thread_ts":"1757695108.506159","reply_count":0,"reply_users_count":0,"latest_reply":null,"is_activity_message":false,"subtype":null,"reactions":[],"files":[],"attachments":[]}

{"id":"dc5cdda43ea063b2463372d5109a694c","ts":"1758022459.227279","type":"message","user":"PERSON_6078_SLACK_ID","text":"Hello <@EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID>,
We are planning to start this project on *September 29*. If you can share the assets with us before that date, we’ll be able to start the optimization and animation processes in advance.
For the items on the board, we can make them editable. This way, aside from the 8-item set that you will provide for the board, you can also test any additional items you’d like to try in the game.
 For the zombies, we will proceed with animations in Spine. You can select which zombies from the platform you’d like to use in the game. Depending on the overall game size, we can finalize the number of zombies during the project.
Here are the asset formats we can work with:
• *3D assets*: .fbx, .glb, or .blend (when exporting .fbx, please make sure it’s exported in *Binary format*, not ASCII)
• *2D assets*: .png (for 2D animations, character parts need to be separated into pieces)
• *Font*: .ttf or .woff2
• *Sound*: .mp3 or .wav

 *Text:* Fonts

• 3D assets: .fbx, .glb, or .blend (when exporting .fbx, please make sure it’s exported in *Binary* format, not ASCII)
